name: orion-knowledge-atlas
description: Search, edit, research, import, and generate in your local Orion Spaces.
long_description: Connect Claude Desktop to Orion's local library and optional native AI workflows. Read and edit notes without an API key, or enable scoped research, source import/reprocessing, generation, concept development, enrichment, and overview refresh while Orion is open. The app retains credentials, provider settings, and atomic writes. Jobs report evidence, coverage, freshness, and cancellation. Includes exact source passages, note sections, concept and link-path navigation, provenance, tasks, guarded text edits, atomic metadata batches, duplicate detection, and integrity checks. All 29 local library tools work while Orion is closed.

tools.name: orion_list_spaces
tools.description: Discover, list, browse, open, or switch between Orion projects, workspaces, and knowledge Spaces; returns valid Space IDs and content counts.

tools.name: orion_browse_space
tools.description: Browse, read, or open the active Orion Space by default, or an explicit Space; returns its living-overview preview and note index.

tools.name: orion_search
tools.description: Search, find, or look up notes and concepts within one Orion project or knowledge Space.

tools.name: orion_get_note
tools.description: Read, open, or retrieve a note with its concepts, sources, connections, and Orion citation.

tools.name: orion_get_source
tools.description: Read, open, or retrieve bounded extracted evidence from an Orion source.

tools.name: orion_get_space_summary
tools.description: Read or summarize the active Orion project's living overview for orientation, then use underlying notes and sources for detailed or cited answers.

tools.name: orion_create_note
tools.description: Write, add, create, and immediately save an ordinary note in one explicit Space.

tools.name: orion_update_note
tools.description: Write, edit, update, and immediately save supplied fields on an existing note in one explicit Space.

tools.name: orion_delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note and clean its Space-scoped references.

tools.name: orion_get_capabilities
tools.description: Check running app availability, workflow grants, and AI/context settings without exposing credentials.

tools.name: orion_get_context
tools.description: Build a local versioned context packet with exact evidence and bounded coverage.

tools.name: orion_research
tools.description: Research, compare, review, find gaps, or prepare a brief using Orion AI and exact Space evidence.

tools.name: orion_import
tools.description: Process text, local files, or public HTTPS sources through Orion extraction and import synthesis.

tools.name: orion_reprocess_sources
tools.description: Reprocess preserved source IDs under new guidance without duplicating provenance.

tools.name: orion_generate
tools.description: Generate and save a note, podcast script, slide deck, or narrated deck with Orion AI.

tools.name: orion_develop_concept
tools.description: Develop a canonical article from an exact origin note and concept title.

tools.name: orion_enrich_knowledge
tools.description: Enrich related Space knowledge from a saved note.

tools.name: orion_refresh_overview
tools.description: Refresh the persistent Space hierarchy and Across this Space overview.

tools.name: orion_get_job
tools.description: Retrieve a job stage or completed bounded result with citations and freshness.

tools.name: orion_list_jobs
tools.description: List recent jobs in one exact enabled Space without result bodies.

tools.name: orion_cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel queued or running work and prevent late note commits.

tools.name: orion_list_sources
tools.description: Page through source metadata, optionally filtering kind, title, or source URL. No source body upload.

tools.name: orion_search_sources
tools.description: Find literal evidence in preserved sources, with Unicode character offsets and source versions. Search is local and case-sensitive; results do not establish AI claims.

tools.name: orion_get_source_passage
tools.description: Read an exact source range, including material beyond ordinary source previews. Offsets count Unicode scalar values, not bytes or UTF-16. Optional version rejects stale ranges.

tools.name: orion_get_note_section
tools.description: Retrieve one Markdown section by heading and occurrence, including its subsections. Ignores fenced code and frontmatter; supports ATX and setext headings. Lists matching headings on ambiguity.

tools.name: orion_get_notes
tools.description: Read up to 12 exact notes from one consistent vault snapshot, sharing a 60,000-character body budget. Returns versions for guarded edits and citations for every note.

tools.name: orion_list_concepts
tools.description: Browse the Space's existing concept vocabulary, with canonical destinations and aliases. Tags remain a separate organizing facet.

tools.name: orion_get_concept
tools.description: Open an exact concept's description, aliases, canonical article, and related note citations. Reports dangling IDs without resolving them in another Space.

tools.name: orion_resolve_link
tools.description: Resolve a phrase using exact normalized note titles, aliases, and canonical concept vocabulary. Returns all distinct destinations when ambiguous; never guesses across Spaces.

tools.name: orion_get_related_notes
tools.description: Rank related notes by explicit links, shared concepts, and shared source provenance. Gives derivation reasons; similarity is not proof of agreement.

tools.name: orion_get_provenance
tools.description: Trace one note to preserved sources and other notes derived from them. Distinguishes forward note references and source backreferences; does not assert that a source supports every claim.

tools.name: orion_list_tags
tools.description: List exact tags and note counts, optionally filtering by tag text. Tags do not create automatic concepts.

tools.name: orion_list_tasks
tools.description: List portable Markdown tasks with exact note versions and line indices. Ignores code/frontmatter; optionally collapses copies with shared provenance while retaining unrelated recurring tasks.

tools.name: orion_set_task_completion
tools.description: Set one exact Markdown task checkbox. Requires its current note version, zero-based line index, and exact raw task text. Does not change another copy of the task.

tools.name: orion_edit_note_text
tools.description: Replace one unique exact substring in a note, guarded by the current note version. Rejects missing or ambiguous selections; preserves all other text and metadata.

tools.name: orion_append_to_note
tools.description: Append exact Markdown to a note with a current-version guard. Inserts no implicit separator. Replaying a completed append with its old version fails instead of duplicating content.

tools.name: orion_batch_update_metadata
tools.description: Atomically set tags and/or pinned state on up to 20 exact versioned notes. Every version must match before anything saves. Preserves bodies, titles, aliases, and unrelated notes.

tools.name: orion_find_duplicate_notes
tools.description: Find duplicate candidates by identical nonempty bodies or normalized titles. Reports the matching basis and bounded scan coverage; never merges or deletes notes.

tools.name: orion_check_space_integrity
tools.description: Audit Space-local references, duplicate IDs, missing canonical targets, and broken explicit Orion links. Reports bounded diagnostics without changing knowledge.

tools.name: orion_get_recent_changes
tools.description: List current notes changed since an RFC3339 timestamp, sorted chronologically. This is current-state metadata, not a historical audit log; deletions and prior bodies are unavailable.

tools.name: orion_get_link_path
tools.description: Find one shortest directed connection path between two exact notes using existing Orion links and persisted relationships. Search has explicit node, edge, text, and hop bounds; returns cited steps and no graph UI.
